sources.t: Ofcom proposes to block new Openreach commercial offer
sources.f: Published 28 July 2026; Ofcom opened a consultation on provisional intervention concerning Openreach commercial offers and network competition.
sources.g: Wholesale offer regulation and discounts do not prove retail service availability at a premises.

sources.t: Automatic compensation: What you need to know
sources.f: Updated 20 July 2026; Ofcom explains automatic compensation for delayed repairs, missed appointments and delayed starts of service.
sources.g: Compensation rules apply when service delivery fails and do not establish initial network reach at a parcel.

sources.t: One million people have mapped their mobile
sources.f: Published 29 May 2026; Ofcom describes postcode-level Map Your Mobile results based on crowdsourced experience and network predictions.
sources.g: Crowdsourced and predicted postal-area evidence is not exact parcel connectivity truth.

sources.t: Connected Nations and infrastructure reports
sources.f: Updated 27 May 2026; the official index links annual and interim fixed and mobile infrastructure reports.
sources.g: Report discovery and national snapshots require separate current address validation.

sources.t: Connected Nations - Planned Network Deployment
sources.f: Updated 13 May 2026; Ofcom explains the statutory basis, confidentiality and limitations of operator deployment forecasts.
sources.g: Operator plans are expressly subject to change and cannot be promoted to current orderability.

sources.t: Quicker complaints resolution and more money when things go wrong
sources.f: Published 8 April 2026; Ofcom records shorter ADR escalation periods and inflation-linked automatic compensation updates.
sources.g: Complaint and compensation protections are consumer-process evidence, not address coverage evidence.

sources.t: Moving landline phones to digital technology
sources.f: Updated 19 February 2026; Ofcom explains PSTN replacement, VoIP migration and power-cut considerations.
sources.g: Technology migration guidance does not establish broadband availability at a particular premises.

sources.t: General Conditions of Entitlement
sources.f: Updated 8 April 2026; the page describes regulatory conditions applying to communications providers in the UK.
sources.g: General provider obligations do not confirm that a network reaches an exact parcel.

sources.t: Switching landline provider
sources.f: Updated 1 July 2026; Ofcom explains One Touch Switch, termination charges, number retention and compensation.
sources.g: Switching procedures presuppose available products and are not independent serviceability evidence.

sources.t: What is line rental and why do I pay it
sources.f: Published 13 December 2024; Ofcom explains shared broadband and telephone access-line maintenance costs.
sources.g: A general explanation of network charging does not prove address-level connection availability.

sources.t: A summary of Ofcom rules for phone and broadband providers
sources.f: Official guidance summarises contract, switching, accessibility, emergency-service and VoIP migration obligations.
sources.g: Regulatory summaries describe duties and do not establish present retail orderability.

sources.t: Protecting customers during migration to digital landlines
sources.f: Published 18 December 2023; Ofcom sets expectations for customer protection, vulnerability support and power resilience during PSTN migration.
sources.g: Migration safeguards do not prove that broadband service is available at an exact premises.

sources.t: January 2026 Project Gigabit contract progress
sources.f: Updated 20 July 2026; BDUK publishes a January snapshot of initial-scope contracted and built premises with rounding and ingestion-lag cautions.
sources.g: Rounded management information is not a live exact-premises service check.

sources.t: February 2026 Project Gigabit contract progress
sources.f: Updated 20 July 2026; BDUK publishes a February contract-level snapshot limited to initial scope.
sources.g: Contract-level data and administrative lag require current UPRN and provider validation.

sources.t: December 2025 Project Gigabit contract progress
sources.f: Updated 20 July 2026; BDUK records a December snapshot and notes rounding, initial-scope limits and data-ingestion lag.
sources.g: Historic programme management data does not establish current parcel orderability.

sources.t: November 2025 Project Gigabit contract progress
sources.f: Updated 19 June 2026; BDUK publishes rounded November 2025 contract and built-premises management information.
sources.g: Rounded historic contract totals cannot confirm a current connection at an address.

sources.t: October 2025 Project Gigabit contract progress
sources.f: Updated 19 June 2026; BDUK publishes the first monthly contract-level snapshot in the series and states its comparison limits.
sources.g: Initial-scope aggregate data is not exact-address retail availability evidence.

sources.t: Closure of First Release Phase 2 and Worcestershire Public Reviews
sources.f: Official outcome records the March 2022 closure of multiple Project Gigabit Public Reviews and the move toward intervention-area finalisation.
sources.g: Historic public-review mapping and procurement intent do not prove present service at a premises.

sources.t: Closure of Second Release Phase 2 Public Reviews
sources.f: Updated 23 June 2026; the outcome records closure of the April 2022 Phase 2 Public Review process.
sources.g: Public-review evidence combines historic existing and planned infrastructure classifications.

sources.t: Closure of Third Release Phase 2 Public Reviews
sources.f: Updated 23 June 2026; the outcome records closure of the July 2022 Third Release Public Reviews.
sources.g: Historic consultation closure and intervention planning are not current provider orderability checks.
